newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius sells $42.2 million of T-Bills.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius sells $42.2 million of T-Bills.

text.p: The central Bank of Mauritius sold 850 million rupees ($42.2 million) of Treasury bills it put on tender sale on Thursday, the bank said.

The central bank said it sold 295.0 million rupees of 91-day, 202.0 million rupees of 182-day and 353.0 million rupees of 364-day bills with average weighted yields of 10.12 percent, 10.76 percent and 10.83 percent, respectively.
This week's effective bank rate was posted at 10.57 percent from 10.59 percent per annum last week, the bank said.
Last week, the bank sold 850 million rupees of 91-, 182- and 364-day Treasury Bills with weighted yields of 10.37 percent, 10.71 percent and 10.73 percent, respectively.
